descriere_scurta: Technology controller motorized potentiometer setpoint after RFG /
descriere: Displays the effective setpoint after the internal ramp-function generator for the motorized potentiometer of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller mot. potentiometer setpoint before RFG /
descriere: Sets the effective setpoint in front of the internal motorized potentiometer ramp-function generator of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller setpoint after ramp-function generator
descriere: Sets the setpoint after the ramp-function generator of the technology controller.
Display and connector output for the smoothed setpoint after the setpoint filter (PT1) of the technology controller.
Display and connector output for the scaled actual value signal of the technology controller.
Display and connector output for the output signal of the technology controller.
Assign a drive data set (= index) the corresponding encoder data set (EDS) for encoder 3. The value corresponds to the number of the assigned encoder data set.

descriere_scurta: LR length unit LU per load path
descriere: Sets the neutral length units LU per load path. Therefore, for a rotary encoder, a reference is established between the physical arrangement and the neutral length units LU used in the drive.

Sets the input terminal for direct measuring probe 2. The direct measuring probe can either be parameterized as a non-cyclic (value 1 ... 6) or a cyclic (value 11 ... 16) measuring probe. After it has been activated via binector input: p2509 = 0/1 signal, the non-cyclic measuring probe measures once and can be used with EPOS. After it has been activated via the p2509 = 1 signal, the cyclic measuring probe measures cyclically and cannot be used with EPOS. In order to process signals faster, the direct measuring probe bypasses the handshake technique via the encoder control word and encoder status word.

Sets the signal source to select the measuring probe. 1 signal = measuring probe 2 is activated for BI: p2509 = 0/1 edge. 0 signal = measuring probe 1 is activated for BI: p2509 = 0/1 edge. Index: [0] = Cl-loop pos ctrl [1] = Encoder 1 [2] = Encoder 2 [3] = Encoder 3

descriere_scurta: LR position actual setting setting value
descriere: Sets the signal source for the setting value of the function "setting position actual value". Index: [0] = Cl-loop pos ctrl [1] = Encoder 1 [2] = Encoder 2 [3] = Encoder 3

Sets the signal source for the edge evaluation of the measuring probe. 1 signal = falling edge of the measuring probe (p2510) is activated for BI: p2509 = 0/1 edge. 0 signal = rising edge of the measuring probe (p2510) is activated for BI: p2509 = 0/1 edge.

descriere_scurta: LR position actual value preprocessing config. DDS changeover
descriere: Sets the behavior of the position actual value preprocessing for the position controller for a DDS changeover. Re p2519 = 1: In the following cases, for a DDS changeover, the actual position actual value becomes invalid and the reference point is reset: - the EDS effective for the closed-loop position control changes. - the encoder assignment changes (p2502). - the mechanical relationships change (p2503 ... p2506). - the direction of rotation changes (p1821). For absolute encoders, the status of the adjustment (p2507) is also reset if the same absolute encoder remains selected for the closed-loop position control, but the mechanical relationships or the direction of rotation have changed. In the operation state, in addition, a fault (F07494) is generated.
Display and BICO output for the status word of the position controller.
Display and connector output for the internal length units LU/motor revolution.
Displays the actual absolute position setpoint.
Display and connector output for the dynamic following error. This value is the deviation, corrected by the velocity-dependent component, between the position setpoint and the position actual value.

descriere_scurta: LR velocity pre-control balancing filter dead time
descriere: Sets the "fractional" dead time to emulate the timing behavior of the velocity control loop. The selected multiplier refers to the position controller clock cycle (deadtime= p2535 * p0115[4]).

descriere_scurta: LR position controller output I component
descriere: Display and connector output for the I component at the output of the position controller (velocity setpoint).

descriere_scurta: is set to 0 and the alarm is deleted.
descriere: Sets the signal source for the STOP cam in the positive direction of travel.
Displays status word 1 for the basic positioner (EPOS).

descriere_scurta: LR position setpoint after setpoint smoothing
descriere: Display and connector output for the position setpoint after setpoint smoothing.

descriere_scurta: LR position controller input system deviation
descriere: Display and connector output for the difference between the position setpoint and the position actual value at the position controller input.

descriere_scurta: LR position controller output P component
descriere: Display and connector output for the P component at the output of the position controller (velocity setpoint).
Display and connector output for the velocity setpoint after limiting (CI: p2541).
Display and connector output for the velocity setpoint as a result of precontrol.
Display and connector output for the total velocity setpoint. This value is obtained from the sum of the velocity pre-control and position controller output.
Display and connector output for the force setpoint.
Display and connector output for the actual following error. This value is the deviation between the position setpoint - after fine interpolation - and the position actual value.
Displays the velocity at the input of the pre-control channel.
Sets the motor distance for the gearbox factor between the motor shaft and load shaft. Gearbox factor = motor distance (p2504) / load path (p2505)

descriere_scurta: EPOS external block change actual position
descriere: Displays the actual position for the following events: - external block change via measuring probe (p2632 = 0, BI: p2661 = 0/1 signal). - external block change via BI: p2633 (p2632 = 1, BI: p2633 = 0/1 signal). - activate traversing task (BI: p2631 = 0/1 signal).

descriere_scurta: EPOS fixed stop maximum following error
descriere: Sets the following error to detect the "fixed stop reached" state (r2526.4).
Display and BICO output for the status word of the controller.

Sets the signal source to select tracking mode. BI: p2655[0] or BI: p2655[1] = 1 signal Tracking mode after withdrawing the enable signal from EPOS (BI: p2656 = 0 signal). BI: p2655[0] and BI: p2655[1] = 0 signal No tracking mode after withdrawing the enable signal from EPOS (BI: p2656 = 0 signal).
Displays the actual velocity setpoint.
Displays the actual effective value for backlash compensation.
Displays the position setpoint presently being processed.
Sets the required task for the traversing block.
Displays the acceleration override presently being processed.
Displays the deceleration override presently being processed.
Displays the task that is presently being processed.
Sets additional information/data of the appropriate task for the traversing block.
Displays the task mode presently being processed.

descriere_scurta: EPOS clearance reference cam and zero mark
descriere: Displays the clearance determined between the reference cam and zero mark in the search for reference.
Displays the current residual distance. The remaining distance is the distance to still to be moved through up to the end of the actual positioning task.
Displays the task parameter presently being processed in the "traversing blocks" operating mode.
Displays the effective force setpoint when reaching the fixed stop (referred to CI: p1522, CI: p1523).

Display and connector output of the actual reference quantity for the frequency (p2000). All frequencies specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word). This parameter has the unit Hz.

Connector output of the reference quantity for voltages p2001. All voltages specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word). This parameter has the unit Vrms.

Displays the actual reference quantity for forces. All forces specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).

Connector output of the reference quantity for powers p2004. All power ratings specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word). The unit of this parameter is the same as the unit selected for p2004.

Connector output of the reference quantity for angles p2005. All angles specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word). This parameter has the unit degree.

Connector output of the reference quantity for temperatures. All temperatures specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word). This parameter has the unit degree Celsius.
Sets the number of rotations that can be resolved for a rotary absolute encoder.

descriere_scurta: LR Position actual value preprocessing corrective value
descriere: Sets the signal source for the corrective value for position actual value preprocessing. Index: [0] = Cl-loop pos ctrl [1] = Encoder 1 [2] = Encoder 2 [3] = Encoder 3
Displays the result of the OR logic operation.
Setting and connector output for a fixed force value.

Display and connector output for frequently used percentage values. Index: [0] = Fixed value +0 % [1] = Fixed value +5 % [2] = Fixed value +10 % [3] = Fixed value +20 % [4] = Fixed value +50 % [5] = Fixed value +100 % [6] = Fixed value +150 % [7] = Fixed value +200 % [8] = Fixed value -5 % [9] = Fixed value -10 % [10] = Fixed value -20 % [11] = Fixed value -50 % [12] = Fixed value -100 % [13] = Fixed value -150 % [14] = Fixed value -200 %
Sets the voltage constant for synchronous motors. Units for rotating synchronous motors: Vrms/(1000 rpm), phase-to-phase
Sets the reluctance torque constant for synchronous motors with reluctance torque (e.g. 1FE ... motors). This parameter has no significance for induction motors.
Setting to invert actual values.

descriere_scurta: Transition point compensation rounding 1 negative zero range
descriere: Sets the rounding for point 1 negative (zero range) of the transition point compensation.
Sets the constant kT1 for the kT characteristic. kT(iq) = kT1 + kT3 * iq^2 + kT5 * iq^4 + kT7 * iq^6
Sets the constant kT3 for the kT characteristic. kT(iq) = kT1 + kT3 * iq^2 + kT5 * iq^4 + kT7 * iq^6

descriere_scurta: Motor rotor leakage inductance / damping inductance d axis
descriere: Sets the rotor/secondary section leakage inductance of the motor. For separately-excited synchronous motors: Sets the damping inductance in the rotor direction (d-axis). This value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2) or using the motor identification routine (p1910) (not for separately-excited synchronous motors).
Sets the maximum velocity for the positive direction.
Sets the permissible deflection when executing the elasticity-based pole position identification. The following setting makes sense: p3094 < p3095

Setting the UTC time. This means that the drive system is synchronized to the time specified by the time master. To start p3101[1] must be written to followed by p3101[0]. After writing to p3101[0], the UTC time is accepted. p3101[0]: Milliseconds p3101[1]: Days
Displays the component number of the oldest fault that is still active.

descriere_scurta: Excitation current outside the tolerance delay time
descriere: Sets the delay time for the "excitation current outside tolerance" message for the excitation current monitoring.
Sets the hysteresis for the "flux outside tolerance" message for the flux monitoring.
Sets the hysteresis speed for the signal "speed deviation model/external" (BO: r2199.7).
Display and binector output of the output signal for the variable signaling function.

For the energy-saving display of a fluid-flow machine, a typical flow characteristic P = f(n) with 5 points along the characteristic is required. This parameter specifies the speed (n) of point 5 as a [%].

For the energy-saving display of a fluid-flow machine, a typical flow characteristic P = f(n) with 5 points along the characteristic is required. This parameter specifies the power (P) of point 5 as a [%].
Displays the internal status of the infeed module.

descriere_scurta: Infeed Vdc controller integral component fast intervention
descriere: Sets the fast Vdc controller intervention for a step-like decrease of the DC link voltage due to a high motor load of the infeed. The Vdc controller fast intervention is de-activated for p3555[5] = 0 % or p3560 < 100% or p0225 > 0.5 * p0223. For a line supply and DC link identification (p3410 >= 2) the level of the fast controller intervention (p3555[2]) is automatically adapted to the line supply inductance.

Displays the identified line supply inductance. The value corresponds to the total inductance between the stiff line supply and the connection point of the Voltage Sensing Module (VSM). Index: [0] = Run 1 [1] = Run 2
Displays the various current values in Smart Mode. Index: [0] = DC link current setpoint [1] = Vdc controller I component [2] = Monitored DC link load current

Sets the time constant for PT1 filtering of the DC-link voltage for the Vdc controller (index 0) and the monitored DC- link load current (index 1) in Smart Mode. Index: [0] = DC link voltage actual value (r3445) [1] = Monitored DC link load current (r3446[2])
Displays the status of the line supply PLL.
Sets the smoothing time for the line supply PLL. Index: [0] = Encoderless operation line supply frequency smoothing time [1] = VSM operation line supply frequency smoothing time
Displays the PLL system deviation.

descriere_scurta: Infeed PLL system deviation after filtering
descriere: Displays the PLL system deviation after filtering.
Displays the active current requirement due to the line filter.

Displays the reactive current requirement as a result of the line filter. The reactive current requirement of a line filter is covered by the controlled infeed/regenerative feedback so that the converter always operates with a power factor of 1 compared to the line.

Display and connector output for the line supply voltage at the input terminals of the line filter in alpha/beta components. Index: [0] = Alpha [1] = Beta [2] = Alpha [3] = Beta [4] = Alpha [5] = Beta

descriere_scurta: cos phi display current signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the current for the cos phi display. Index: [0] = Alpha subsystem 1 [1] = Beta subsystem 1 [2] = Alpha subsystem 2 [3] = Beta subsystem 2

Displays the reserve controller output for the modulation depth. The DC link voltage is increased by this voltage value - the summed setpoint for the DC link voltage is output in r0088. The summed setpoint is limited to the maximum steady-stage DC link voltage (p0280).
Display and connector output for the status word of the infeed.

descriere_scurta: Infeed active current controller unlimited setpoint
descriere: Display and connector output for the unlimited setpoint of the active current controller. For a master-slave infeed configuration, the master retrieves this setpoint and distributes it to all of the slaves. The slaves operate in the current-controlled mode.
Sets the scaling factor for the power pre-control.
Sets the filter time for power pre-control.
Display and binector output for the status of the current limits.
Displays the maximum permissible current for the line filter set using p0220[0].

descriere_scurta: Master/slave active current setpoint multiplexer output
descriere: Displays (connector output) the output for the multiplexer. The signal value is used as standard for the active current setpoint for the slave infeed.

descriere_scurta: Master/slave DC link voltage monitoring status
descriere: Displays the status of the DC link voltage monitoring for the master/slave.

descriere_scurta: Master/slave current distribution factor multiplexer output
descriere: Display and connector output for the multiplexer output value. The signal value is used as standard for the current distribution factor for the infeed master slave operation.
Displays the status of the closed-loop infeed control.
